description: This Java source file 'UtilXml.java' provides utility methods for XML processing within the Apache OFBiz framework. It includes functions for parsing, reading, writing, and manipulating XML documents using DOM and SAX parsers, as well as serialization with XStream. The class also contains helper methods for handling XML nodes, elements, attributes, and error handling, plus DTD resolution. It is a comprehensive utility class tailored for simplifying XML interactions in the framework.

classes.name: UtilXml
classes.description: A utility class for XML parsing, serialization, and manipulation within OFBiz framework, encapsulating DOM/SAX operations, DTD handling, and object marshalling.

classes.name: UtilXml.LocalResolver
classes.description: EntityResolver implementation for resolving local DTDs and schemas, to avoid external network dependencies during XML parsing.

classes.name: UtilXml.LocalErrorHandler
classes.description: ErrorHandler implementation for XML validation, logs errors, fatal errors, and warnings during XML parsing.

methods.name: getDomLsImplementation
methods.description: Returns a DOMImplementationLS instance for DOM Level 3 Load and Save operations.

methods.name: writeXmlDocument
methods.description: Serializes a DOM Node to an OutputStream using DOM Level 3 LS.

methods.name: createOutputTransformer
methods.description: Creates a Transformer configured for pretty-printing XML output with specified encoding and indentation options.

methods.name: fromXml
methods.description: Deserializes XML from InputStream, Reader, or String into Java objects using XStream.

methods.name: toXml
methods.description: Serializes Java objects into XML String, OutputStream, or Writer using XStream.

methods.name: readXmlDocument
methods.description: Parses XML content from String, URL, InputStream, or URLConnection into a DOM Document, with optional validation and position info.

methods.name: makeEmptyXmlDocument
methods.description: Creates a new empty DOM Document, optionally with a specified root element.

methods.name: addChildElement
methods.description: Creates and appends a new child Element to a parent Element.

methods.name: addChildElementValue
methods.description: Creates and appends a new child Element with a text value.

methods.name: childElementList
methods.description: Returns a list of child Elements with optional filtering by name, set of names, or varargs.

methods.name: firstChildElement
methods.description: Returns the first child Element matching provided name(s) or prefix-ignore.

methods.name: elementValue
methods.description: Retrieves concatenated text content from an Element, including CDATA sections.

methods.name: nodeValue
methods.description: Retrieves concatenated node values from a Node and its siblings.

methods.name: getAttributeValueIgnorePrefix
methods.description: Gets attribute value from an Element ignoring namespace prefix.

methods.name: convertDocumentToXmlString
methods.description: Serializes a DOM Document into formatted XML String.

methods.name: createApacheLicenceComment
methods.description: Generates an XML Comment node containing Apache License header.
